darkAbyss.role: Primary background across all terminals and dashboards

electricBlue.role: Active states, primary CTA, and counselor intelligence indicators

metallicSilver.role: Secondary typography, borders, and inactive iconography

dataGreen.role: Operational fleet status and verified execution hooks

iceWhite.role: Primary wordmark, crown highlights, and high-contrast headings

cyanCoreGlow.role: Central AI core and active circuit node highlights

shieldInteriorNavy.role: Shield body interior and elevated card surface

shieldLowerSteel.role: Lower shield facet shading and secondary structural accents

display.family: Archon Bold, SF Pro Display, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
display.usage: Primary Branding, Hero Headers, Module Titles

secondary.usage: UI Controls, Body Copy, Fleet Metrics, Documentation

monospace.family: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace
monospace.usage: Terminal Output, Agent Logs, Configuration Files

prohibitedModifications: Never modify core proportions of the shield geometry
Never substitute unauthorized neon accent colors
Never stretch the 16:9 presentation card directly into a 1:1 square icon
Never replace the Crowned Circuit-Shield emblem with a generic monogram
